Card Q&A.a: No, you can't ignore its color requirements. The breeding area can't be referenced unless the effect specifies the breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's 1st effect to ignore this card's color requirements while I have a Digimon with the [LIBERATOR] trait in the breeding area?

Effect: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [LIBERATOR] trait, you can ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 4.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait and a play cost of 4 or less from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
